profile_text.body:
Endava is a publicly traded technology services company, listed under the ticker DAVA and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001656081. On its own site it describes itself as combining engineering, AI-native delivery and industry expertise to help businesses, and says it works with customers on accelerating growth, navigating complex challenges and adapting to changing markets. It presents its services around bringing new products to life and helping clients apply AI as part of a broader digital shift.

The site describes Dava.X as the company's framework for providing tailored expertise in areas including AI, core modernisation and cloud, aimed at helping clients adopt and implement technologies quickly and at scale. Endava says it combines data, AI and intelligent automation with creative and other technologies to deliver technology solutions for its customers.

No AI products, lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
